
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/ssvip/p/19937983" title="发布于 2026-04-27 15:52">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">windows装gitlab服务器</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>windows装gitlab服务器，用docker，然后装在docker里是最好方案。</p>
<h1>1、安装Docker</h1>
<p>首先，我们到docker官方网站，点击Download Docker Desktop</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1149552/202604/1149552-20260427144550670-1652220987.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>下载完成后，不断点击安装就行。如果安装时，提示windows版本太低，则要升级windows系统。</p>
<p>安装完毕后，我们打开docker，如果提示wsl版本低，则去powershell中运行以下命令：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:csharp;gutter:true;">wsl --update
</pre>
</div>
<p>　　升级完毕后，则如下图：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1149552/202604/1149552-20260427144759081-375454342.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h1>2、安装Gitlab</h1>
<p>&nbsp;（1）、powershell执行下列命令，拉取gitlab镜像：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:csharp;gutter:true;">docker pull registry.gitlab.cn/omnibus/gitlab-jh:17.3.1-jh.0
</pre>
</div>
<p>　　则会下载gitlab，我需要的是GitLab v17.3.1-jh，所以把具体版本号也加上了。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1149552/202604/1149552-20260427145152943-2097984624.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;（2）、新建三个文件夹，以存放gitlab文件</p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:csharp;gutter:true;">mkdir D:\gitlab\config
mkdir D:\gitlab\logs
mkdir D:\gitlab\data
</pre>
</div>
<p>（3）、启动容器，把命令在powershell里运行</p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:csharp;gutter:true;">docker run -d `
  --name gitlab-jh `
  --hostname gitlab-jh `
  --restart always `
  -p 80:80 `
  -p 443:443 `
  -p 2222:22 `
  -v D:\gitlab\config:/etc/gitlab `
  -v D:\gitlab\logs:/var/log/gitlab `
  -v D:\gitlab\data:/var/opt/gitlab `
  --shm-size 256m `
  -e GITLAB_OMNIBUS_CONFIG="external_url 'http://localhost'; gitlab_rails['gitlab_shell_ssh_port'] = 2222" `
  registry.gitlab.cn/omnibus/gitlab-jh:17.3.1-jh.0　</pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;（4）、运行这个命令后，很快就执行完。但gitlab需要几分钟，乃至十几分钟的启动时间。可以用命令：docker logs -f gitlab-jh来查看状态，界面会一直滚动</p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:csharp;gutter:true;">docker logs -f gitlab-jh
</pre>
</div>
<p>　　像出现以下的界面，则是已经启动完毕。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1149552/202604/1149552-20260427151512168-1715398183.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>在docker里亦能看到状态：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1149552/202604/1149552-20260427151819934-1689828426.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;(5)、在浏览器中输入localhost,就能看到运行的效果了：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1149552/202604/1149552-20260427153355759-947750024.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;（6）、密码则用以下命令查看：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:csharp;gutter:true;">docker exec -it gitlab-jh cat /etc/gitlab/initial_root_password
</pre>
</div>
<p>　　</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1149552/202604/1149552-20260427153611246-181145111.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;（7）、用密码登录后，则可看到主页：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1149552/202604/1149552-20260427153751472-448570355.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h1>&nbsp;数据迁移</h1>
<p>假如已经有已经备份的文件和配置文件&nbsp;</p>
<p>（1）、停止GitLab服务</p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:csharp;gutter:true;">docker exec -it gitlab-jh gitlab-ctl stop puma
docker exec -it gitlab-jh gitlab-ctl stop sidekiq
</pre>
</div>
<p>　　</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1149552/202604/1149552-20260427154122625-860772101.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;（2）、备份文件复制到d:\gitlab\data\backups文件夹</p>
<p>&nbsp;（3）、给权限</p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:csharp;gutter:true;">docker exec -it gitlab-jh chown git:git /var/opt/gitlab/backups/*.tar
</pre>
</div>
<p>　　</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1149552/202604/1149552-20260427154511529-1602635203.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>（4）、执行恢复命令</p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:csharp;gutter:true;">docker exec -it gitlab-jh gitlab-backup restore BACKUP=【备份文件名前缀】
</pre>
</div>
<p>　　</p>
<p>&nbsp;（5）、把配置文件gitlab.rb、gitlab-secrets.json放到D:\gitlab\config\文件夹下。如果不恢复配置文件，则无法登录</p>
<p>&nbsp; （6）、运行恢复配置文件命令：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:csharp;gutter:true;">docker exec -it gitlab-jh gitlab-ctl reconfigure
</pre>
</div>
<p>　（7）、重启gitlab</p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:csharp;gutter:true;">docker exec -it gitlab-jh gitlab-ctl restart
</pre>
</div>
<p>　　重新登录则看到自己恢复的项目</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>

</div>
